group: birds: Anseriformes waterfowl beaks (Olsen 2017 Evolution: 51 species on Burleigh_2015.tre; 2D dorsal/lateral upper-bill culmen & tomium contour landmarks)

data.landmarks: Olsen AM 2017 Evolution 71:1143-1153; Dryad/Zenodo 5001646 (`Beak shape by species.zip`: 51 waterfowl species, 3D/2D upper-bill culmen and tomium curves).
data.phylogeny: Pruned ML phylogeny `Burleigh, Kimball, Braun, 2015 ML Tree, pruned.tre` (51 matched species).

what_thompson_specifically_adds: Tests the portfolio's bird beak clade on a continuous 2D beak profile (dorsal culmen + ventral tomium outline across ducks, geese, swans, mergansers, screamers). Because the rhamphotheca/premaxilla develops from a single BMP4/Calmodulin growth zone (Abzhanov et al. 2004, Campàs et al. 2010), bird beak outlines should be among the most Thompsonian structures in vertebrates.

hypotheses.statement: Bird beak profiles are exceptionally Thompsonian: across the 51 waterfowl species, the 7 a-priori Thompson modes capture > 80% of between-species Procrustes variance on the 2D lateral beak outline (exceeding fish bodies at 57.9%).
hypotheses.reasoning: Campàs et al. (2010) showed that avian beak shapes collapse onto simple scaling/shearing transformations; a smooth culmen-tomium contour has no decoupled interior modules.

hypotheses.statement: Phylogenetic signal on the 51-species waterfowl tree is strong: Pagel's lambda > 0.7 (best model != White Noise) in both Thompson-7 and full PCA-95% spaces.
hypotheses.reasoning: Grazing geese, dabbling ducks, diving pochards, and fish-catching mergansers form strongly conserved phylogenetic clades.

hypotheses.statement: Leave-one-species-out phylogenetic prediction beats the grand consensus by a wide margin (median Procrustes RMS ratio < 0.75, paired one-sided Wilcoxon p < 0.001).
hypotheses.reasoning: Matches the 0.95 subjective prior registered for birds in `thompson_dataset_portfolio.json`.

hypotheses.statement: Thompson-7 captures > 80% of the full-space phylogenetic prediction gain relative to consensus.
hypotheses.reasoning: Because >80% of beak shape variance lies in Thompson-7, the 7-mode basis should retain nearly all of the phylogenetic predictive power.
